title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30352: add SkipNewExpirationDateCheck to OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot
summary: A new parameter SkipNewExpirationDateCheck was added to the OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot event, allowing subscribers to bypass the mandatory New Expiration Date validation during item journal posting without affecting other logic.
key_points: Adds var SkipNewExpirationDateCheck parameter to OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot integration event
Subscribers can set this parameter to true to skip the TestField check for New Expiration Date
Allows bypassing validation without requiring replication of entire procedures or affecting downstream events
Applied across W1 base layer and all country-specific layers (ES, APAC, CH, RU, IT)
